description: Fifteen synthetic English support tickets authored for this portfolio evaluation before model inference; not real customer data or an independently annotated benchmark.
annotation_policy: Assign only the specific issue category. Reserve Technical Issue for application malfunction, not every login or connectivity issue. Use Account Management for requested account/profile changes, Login Problem for authentication, Billing for charges/refunds, Connectivity for connection failures. Labels are project-defined and not uniquely authoritative.

cases.text: The desktop application crashes whenever I open the settings page.
Exporting my report produces a blank PDF even though the report contains data.
The save button does nothing and my edits disappear after I reload the page.
My correct password is rejected and I cannot sign in.
The sign-in verification code expires immediately, so I cannot access my account.
After resetting my password, the login page still says invalid credentials.
My card was charged twice for the same monthly subscription. Please refund the duplicate charge.
The invoice shows a higher amount than the price on my subscription plan.
I was billed after my subscription ended and would like the payment returned.
Please change the email address associated with my profile.
I want to permanently delete my account and its profile information.
How can I update the company name shown in my account profile?
The service disconnects from the network every few minutes while I am working.
The app says it cannot reach the server, although other websites load normally.
My session keeps losing its internet connection and reconnecting.
